extracted.name: Blueberry Torte
extracted.description: This blueberry torte includes a graham cracker crust, cream cheese custard, and blueberry pie filling for a quick and easy cheesecake-like dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®)
instruction_lines: Mix graham crackers, butter, and white sugar together in a medium bowl until well combined; press mixture into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Chill crust in the refrigerator until firm, about 1 hour.
Beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar together in a large bowl until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes. Fold in whipped topping until incorporated.
Spread cream cheese mixture evenly onto crust; top with blueberry pie filling. Chill in the refrigerator until firm, 4 hours or overnight.
